newsitem.title: USA: Pyramid Breweries sees Q3 EPS $0.08-$0.10.
newsitem.headline: Pyramid Breweries sees Q3 EPS $0.08-$0.10.

text.p: Pyramid Breweries Inc said beer sales in July and August were lower than expected, which will result in per-share earnings of about $0.08 to $0.10, below analysts' views of $0.15 per share.
In a released statement, the company said it expects its third-quarter sales will be comparable to the same period in 1995, which is also below analysts' expectations.
Pyramid previously announced it accelerated expenditures for its geographic expansion and added distribution into four additional states, including Maine, Michigan, Minnesota and New Hampshire.
The shortfalls are a "result primarily of slower sales and the accelerated expenditures for geographic expansion," the company said.

"Although sales in Washington are comparable to the prior year, and Oregon sales have declined from the prior year due to increased competition, sales in areas outside of Washington and Oregon continue to increase," Pyramid said.
